decision.framework: AdaMBind-inspired target-task partial meta-adaptation is NOT admitted to the production model
decision.complementary_arm_C: REJECTED — its adapter is inert; what advantage it shows over T is a zero-shot trunk effect, not a few-shot mechanism
decision.naive_hybrid_H: REJECTED — improves MSE while degrading ranking at every k, the preregistered stop pattern; its correction is 99.7% level
decision.meta_only_M: REJECTED — a learned level-transporter that is worse than fixed Tanimoto at k>=3 and whose ranking collapses at k=5
decision.promotion: none. No code moved to model/ or scripts/.

framework_attribution: Framework inspiration only. NOT a reproduction of AdaMBind, MAML, ANIL, Meta-SGD or FS-CAP, and nothing here evaluates those methods.
evidence_grade: development, single seed, directional screening. Not a performance claim. meta_test not read.
dataset: governed BindingDB-Ki bindingdb_ki_double_cold_v1 only; no Davis/KIBA/ChEMBL/structural merge; no cross-dataset support, retrieval, normalization, label or checkpoint

checkpoint_selection.rule: meta_train internal-validation components only (227 fit / 31 internal)
checkpoint_selection.note: partitioned by homology component, never by target

headline_finding_leakage.statement: Selecting checkpoints on meta_val — the rule Stage A and the incumbent trainer use — is worth about 0.62 pK^2 at k=0 on the very population it then reports.
headline_finding_leakage.diagnostic: Tleak: identical arm, identical 227 fit components, meta_val selection
headline_finding_leakage.scale_comparison: the leak (0.618) is 5.6x the largest mechanism effect measured in this cycle (0.111) and 10.7x the recorded same-config retraining spread (0.058)
headline_finding_leakage.consequence: every meta_val figure produced by the standard trainer, including the recorded incumbent band, is an optimistic development estimate by roughly this margin

root_cause.statement: The readout's ligand representation is nearly constant within a target, so a 97-parameter partial inner loop can only express a level shift.
root_cause.algebra: a weight update dw = -lr * sum_i c_i h_i moves query q by <dw, h_q>; with h_i ~ h_j this is the same for every query (a level shift), and if c is mean-zero then sum_i c_i h_i ~ (sum_i c_i) hbar = 0 and the adapter produces nothing
explains: H's correction being 99.7% level (|meta| 0.15-0.18 vs |centered shape| 0.0004-0.0006)
C's adapter being inert once the level is removed from its target
why the collapse is not created by the readout MLP: embed's spread (0.033) already equals h's (0.034)

G4_no_material_ranking_loss.note: C IMPROVES ranking, resolved at every k

G5_beats_transport_only_and_meta_only.note: C loses to M on MSE at k=1 and k=2

G6_depends_on_correct_support_more_than_.note: C depends on correct support LESS than the baseline

why_C_fails_is_not_what_it_looks_like.observation: C beats T on MSE at k=1 (resolved) and k=2 (resolved) and improves Spearman at every k (all resolved)
why_C_fails_is_not_what_it_looks_like.but: C's meta correction is inert — |meta| is 0.0000 at k=1, 0.0006 at k=2, 0.0434 at k=3, 0.0389 at k=5 (normalized units), and its no-adaptation control is +0.0004 / -0.0360 / -0.0159, i.e. removing the adapter changes nothing or helps
why_C_fails_is_not_what_it_looks_like.proof: the C-minus-T ranking contrast is bitwise identical at k=0 and k=1 (+0.052852 pearson, +0.092001 spearman, +0.036328 CI) because at k=1 C's meta is exactly zero and the transport is a pure level shift, which cannot reorder queries
why_C_fails_is_not_what_it_looks_like.conclusion: C's entire advantage over T is a ZERO-SHOT TRUNK difference produced by training with the complementary objective, not by the few-shot mechanism it deploys. It is a training-time regularization effect and must not be reported as evidence for meta-adaptation.

H_triggers_the_stop_pattern.statement: MSE improves while ranking degrades at every k — the preregistered stop condition. The mechanism explains it: a 99.7%-level correction improves squared error by recalibrating the target mean and cannot help ordering.

counterfactuals_note.interpretation: the incumbent Tanimoto transport is label-driven by construction, so a large correct-vs-wrong gap is expected and is NOT evidence for the inner loop. Stage A reported this gap for A1 only and attributed it to adaptation; the corrected difference-of-differences shows C's incremental dependence is negative.

stop_rules_triggered: the complementary arm does not beat both constituent mechanisms (loses to M on MSE at k=1, k=2)
improvement is only level calibration (H: 99.7% level; M: 99.7% level)
ranking degrades while MSE improves (H at every k)
not_triggered: k=0 is not harmed — C and H both improve it
no leakage or bank mismatch in Stage B itself
improvement is not confined to high-similarity recall (low-recall stratum favours C and H)
what_is_worth_keeping: the leakage measurement: meta_val checkpoint selection is worth ~0.62 pK^2 at k=0 and must be removed from any future comparison
the root-cause measurement: within-target ligand representations are nearly identical (cosine 0.997), which bounds what ANY partial-head adaptation can do

the observation that training with a complementary-residual objective improved the ZERO-SHOT trunk (C vs T: Spearman +0.092 at k=0, resolved) — a training-time effect worth its own preregistered test, and explicitly NOT evidence for meta-adaptation
next_step: Do not add attention blocks, full-backbone MAML, learned selectors or extra datasets. The measured obstacle is representational collapse within a target at the readout input, which no adaptation rule downstream of it can repair.
